description: Scrape a webpage with custom options

aiPrompt.description: AI-powered extraction/analysis of the scraped page, always run against the Markdown regardless of format. Shape depends on 'type': prompt (query), schema (schema), listing (itemSchema, maxItems), summary (style, focus, maxLength), sentiment (aspects), keywords (maxKeywords, includeEntities). Adds +7 credits

extractionMode.description: JSON output is used automatically when an extraction mode is requested. Set to template to use a ready-made extraction template

extractionSchema.description: Extraction schema for cssSchema/xpathSchema modes: { name, baseSelector?, fields: [{ name, selector, type, attribute?, fields? }] }, or a flat { name, fields: [{ title, value }] } for default mode

fileOutput.description: Return a download URL instead of inline data

proxyCountry.description: Country code (ISO alpha-2) to route the request through a proxy in. Can be used on its own without proxyMode

proxyMode.description: false never uses a proxy (default), auto tries without a proxy first and retries through one if blocked, true always uses a proxy

renderJS.description: Whether to render JavaScript. If omitted, resolved automatically: fetched without a browser first, then rendered only if the page needs it

template.description: Ready-made extraction template when extractionMode is 'template'. product extracts title/brand/pricing/availability/images/ratings; contact extracts company/locations/emails/phones/social profiles

waitTime.description: Seconds to wait after page load before capturing content

name: webScrape
